title: IRL Speaker
extensionText: Browser source for triggering sounds from Streamer.bot while IRL streaming

options.name: wsHost
options.label: Host
options.description: The host of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: wsPort
options.label: Port
options.description: The port number of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: wsEndpoint
options.label: Endpoint
options.description: The endpoint of the Streamer.bot Websocket server to connect to

options.name: secure
options.label: Secure?
options.description: Required when using a tunnel to connect to a remote host. Usually you'll set port to 443 when using this

options.name: wsPassword
options.label: Websocket Password
options.description: Password for your Streamer.bot Websocket server if enforcing authentication

options.name: soundsEndpoint
options.label: Sounds Endpoint
options.description: The endpoint of the HTTP server serving your sound files. Default:/sounds

options.name: timeout
options.label: Sound length limit (in seconds)
options.description: Sounds longer than this will be cut off

options.name: nodeHost
options.label: Node Server Host
options.description: The host of the Node server serving the sound files. Should be accessible via your preference of networking. Default:/irl
